detail.longDescription: When you're stuck, "just start" is useless advice. The useful question is what's actually in the way: not knowing where to begin, the task feeling too big, low energy, or distraction. Our app Now has a Stuck button that asks exactly that and gives you one practical next move. Free core, no account. https:// apps.apple.com/us/app/now-adhd -task-starter/id6794488304 # ADHD # productivity # executivefunction # AIassisted
